missions.name: For the Hearth
objectives: Harvest a male Mule deer near your Lodge. Choose to taxidermy it when harvesting.

missions.name: For the Hunt
objectives: Place a male Mule deer in a diorama with a mid-sized herbivore in your lodge.
Take a look at your surroundings at a Map board in the Lodge.

missions.name: Angel on your shoulder
objectives: Check out the Hearth & Hunt files on the locals.

missions.name: Fox Fires
objectives: Analyze any Dall sheep feeding or resting zones. The areas where to find them are highlighted on the Hunting map.
Harvest a Dall sheep.

missions.name: Loudest deer
objectives: Harvest a male Rocky Mountain elk. Its Fitness must be 70% or higher.

missions.name: Pack Dynamics
objectives: Animals possess intelligence that often surprises people. The older and fitter an animal is, the better it conceals itself. Calling becomes essential.

missions.name: One shot, no waste
objectives: Save up money and buy a better rifle for larger animals so meat is not damaged by improper ammunition.

missions.name: Heterochromia Iridum
objectives: Harvest a male White-tailed deer with your Dog companion active at the time of the shot.
Have your Dog companion successfully find and follow the blood trail of any shot White-tailed deer.

missions.name: Who let the bloodhounds out?
objectives: Shoot and harvest an Elk between 00:00-05:00 with your Dog companion active at the time of the shot.

missions.name: Friendly competition
objectives: Shoot and harvest 3 Wolverines.

missions.name: Parasomnias
objectives: Locate and harvest the lone Dall sheep.

missions.name: Pieris Marginalis
objectives: Find invasive plant species in the location highlighted on your Map and remove them.
Create a butterfly garden.

missions.name: Cercyonis Pegala
objectives: Harvest 3 White-tailed deer with their Fitness at 60% or lower.

missions.name: Eynnis lucilius
objectives: Harvest the sick moose in the highlighted area on the hunting map. (0/3)

missions.name: Speiredonia mutabilis
objectives: Get to the area of the last known sighting of the moose with bloodied antlers.

missions.name: Tyria Jacobaeae
objectives: Enter the swamps and get ready for the moose with bloodied antlers.
Option 1: Shoot and harvest the moose with bloodied antlers. Option 2: Leave the highlighted zone and let the moose live.
Talk to Regina. Talk to Patrick.

missions.name: Crystal clarity
objectives: Harvest an animal using a bow sight.
Harvest an animal using a crossbow sight.
Harvest an animal with a bolt-action rifle without using a scope.

missions.name: Talk turkey to me
objectives: Call 3 Wild turkeys to a distance of 100 m or less from you.

missions.name: Hunting Solo
objectives: Harvest 5 Mallards without using your Dog companion. Each bird must weigh 1.3 kg or more.

missions.name: Wattle Bearers
objectives: Harvest 2 female Wild turkeys with Fitness 60% or lower.
Harvest 2 male Wild turkeys with Fitness 60% or lower.

missions.name: Cycle of Life
objectives: Harvest 3 Snowshoe hares. Each animal must weigh 1.3 kg or more.

missions.name: Iconic pairing
objectives: Create a taxidermy diorama with a Grizzly bear and a Wood Bison.

missions.name: Weather Extremes
objectives: Harvest a Dall sheep. Shoot it only once from 400 m or more with the Primacy Vision Unity scope attached.

missions.name: Fifteen stars
objectives: Harvest 3 Elk with their Trophy ratings at 5 stars.

missions.name: Bison Bank
objectives: Harvest a male Bison with its Fitness at 40% or higher.

missions.name: Lure in
objectives: Harvest a male Grizzly bear using a luring scent.

missions.name: Zip up
objectives: Harvest a Mule deer. Shoot it between 00:00-03:00 with a night vision scope attached.

missions.name: Superhero of the wilderness
objectives: Harvest a Wolverine using a tripod stand.

missions.name: Quail country
objectives: Harvest a male White-tailed ptarmigan with Fitness 60% or higher.
Harvest a female White-tailed ptarmigan with Fitness 60% or higher.

missions.name: Which one has a white butt?
objectives: Harvest a White-tailed deer with a 5-star Trophy rating.
Harvest a Mule deer with a 5-star Trophy rating.

missions.name: Super pigs
objectives: Call a Wild boar with Fitness 80% or more. Make sure it reacts and wait until it is 100 m away or closer.

missions.name: MooseNews
objectives: Harvest a Moose. Shoot it only once using the .338 Lapua Magnum caliber.

missions.name: Artificial route
objectives: Harvest a Pronghorn with Fitness 70% or higher. Shoot it only once to the heart from 200 m or more.
